name: Package of Empty Ooze Containers
summary: This package is a kit of specialized, empty specimen jars supplied by the gnome researcher Laris Geardawdle in Ironforge. Intended for dangerous field sampling in the blighted forests of Felwood, it contains jars designed to safely hold tainted and cursed ooze extracts without dissolving.

sections.title: Field Research Equipment
sections.body: Containing a dozen empty jars—split between containers meant for cursed and tainted oozes—this kit was assembled by Laris Geardawdle for intrepid travelers heading out to Felwood. Because raw ooze specimens are notoriously caustic and prone to digesting ordinary luggage, sturdy, sealed glass is essential for transporting the acidic residues across continents back to the tinker's workbench in Ironforge.

sections.title: The Mystery of the Ooze
sections.body: Geardawdle's interest in ooze is far from a simple eccentric hobby. Noticing that Forsaken researchers from the Royal Apothecary Society routinely harvest these bizarre organisms across Azeroth, he suspects oozes may hold profound secrets about the world's origin. Geardawdle theorizes that slimes might be primordial secretions connected to the planet's very creation, and he relies on field agents using this kit to collect the evidence he needs to win acclaim within the Explorers' League.

faq.q: What is inside the package of empty ooze containers?
faq.answer: The package contains twelve specimen jars: six empty jars calibrated for cursed ooze and six designated for tainted ooze.

aliases: where do i get the ooze package
faq.answer: It is handed to Alliance adventurers by Laris Geardawdle, a gnomish scholar and researcher working out of Ironforge.

faq.q: Where are these containers meant to be used?
aliases: where do i use ooze jars
faq.answer: They are intended for use in the corrupted wilderness of Felwood, where adventurers must defeat tainted and cursed oozes to harvest residue samples directly from the fallen creatures.

faq.q: Why does Laris Geardawdle want these ooze samples?
faq.answer: Laris has noticed the Forsaken Royal Apothecary Society gathering ooze across the world and wants to uncover their secrets. He also harbors an unconventional theory that slimes might be primordial secretions tied to the creation of Azeroth, and hopes proving it will earn him status in the Explorers' League.

angles.text: Laris Geardawdle sees this ooze research as a vital opportunity to show the Dwarves of Ironforge that hosting refugee gnomes was well worth the trouble.
Gathering these samples helps the Alliance keep pace with the unsettling research being conducted by the Forsaken's Royal Apothecary Society.
